description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based application interfacing with the CCS811 sensor, including sensor data fetching, trigger handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: now_str
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the current uptime in HH:MM:SS.MMM format.

methods.name: do_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data from the CCS811 device and prints CO2, TVOC, voltage, and current readings.

methods.name: trigger_handler
methods.description: Handles sensor trigger events by performing a fetch and printing the result.

methods.name: do_main
methods.description: Main loop that periodically fetches sensor data every second.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes the device, fetches configuration, sets up triggers, and starts data acquisition.
